scale_rule: world size = px × 0.00386 m (沈砚 1.70 m = 440 px, characters_v3.json). Prop sprites are BILLBOARD_FIXED_Y cards like characters: the named vertical measure is scaled to its real height.
anchor_rule: anchor_foot = ground contact point at the base center, in that PNG's pixel coords; y-sort by anchor_foot; shadow png has the same canvas and is placed at the same position on the ground layer.
